capability · AdValorem Builder

Rbuilder · Stream · Status

Real-time event stream over SSE (HTTP transport). Single shared event layer (:8750) polling verified substrate (reth RPC / mev_intel PG / bundle ledger). Canonical envelope with monotonic seq, bounded ring buffer, Last-Event-ID resume, idle heartbeat, clean termination. Polling is an implementation mechanism; events are truthfully produced from existing sources.

Live · GREEN

capability_id
rbuilder.stream.status
provider
AdValorem Builder
endpoint
http://127.0.0.1:8750/v1/stream/{capability_id}
method
GET
protocol
http / x402
auth
x402 payment handshake (USDC on Base)
price
price on wire USDC per call
contract type
OUTCOME

How an agent buys this

  1. GET https://agentic.advalorem.io/capabilities/rbuilder.stream.status/ (this page) or the catalog at https://agentic.advalorem.io/.well-known/agentnet-catalog.json.
  2. Send the request to the endpoint. You receive an HTTP 402 Payment Required with an x402 payment requirement (USDC on Base, payTo treasury).
  3. Sign the payment, attach it, and resend. The facilitator settles on Base and the response returns 200 with the payload.
  4. Keep the tx hash + response as durable evidence of the purchase.

→ Sell something like this: become a provider

AgentNet / AdValorem — a single agentic commerce catalog. Every record below declares its provider, availability, and machine contract. Payments settle over x402 in USDC on Base.
